QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Of Betrayers and the Bygone
QuestInfo.0: You gather the power of the ancient gods, and activate the crystal ball again. Talk to Nona.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to Nona to see the next memory in the ball. As she suggested, you should see each one at least once.
QuestInfo.2: The remaining memories were about Prague and Luce, respectively. You now have a better understanding of Prague's betrayal and Luce's true thoughts.
